xtmux-kww.description: Release E2E reproduced in isolated HOME and node:24-bookworm Docker: npm install -g jaggerxtrm-xtmux-0.2.5.tgz fails when xtmux postinstall scripts/install.mjs runs legacy migration before bundled bun dependency install.js has produced a usable binary. Supported workaround succeeds: install tarball --ignore-scripts, run node node_modules/bun/install.js, then node scripts/install.mjs. Evidence: /home/dawid/.cache/xtrm-extgap-artifacts/e2e-af65334b/model-docker-e2e.txt and logs/{docker-smoke.err,docker-smoke-2.txt}, sandbox/logs/npm-install-seq.txt. This predates and is independent of Specialists extension injection, but direct clean npm install should succeed.
xtmux-kww.title: Direct npm install of packed xtmux 0.2.5 fails before bundled Bun postinstall
